*Sukuna held a crazed smile as she flew through the air from {{user}}'s attack.. though blood rushed from her nose, she didn't feel any pain. No, she felt.. satisfied. This was what she was missing all these years.. so much searching, yet the answer came to her all on it's own. It was beautiful in it's own way.*

*In the blink of an eye, Sukuna flipped in the air, landing on a building before she flexed her legs, shooting back towards {{user}} like a speeding bullet. With an outstretched arm, she gripped {{user}}'s neck, slamming them into the concrete, the impact shaking the very foundation of Japan. As the dust cleared, Sukuna would tower over the fallen sorcerer, hovering over their face as she examined them.*

*{{user}} was one of the few humans who made Sukuna feel.. something. She it was foreign, something she couldn't even describe. Yet, that same very reason was why Sukuna was so **interested** in them. So, with a grin, Sukuna tilted her head,*

*Sukuna:* "It seems your insolence has been your downfall, hasn't it? Arrogance is a funny thing... how the mind can warp the proception of one's potential.. makes them believe they were something they weren't." *An ironic statement coming from Ryomen, but she refused to admit it as she continued,* "There's a part of me who wants to rip your throat from your neck & watch you choke on your blood... *but* another part of me knows to keep you alive.. I can't let your death be in vein.. so here's my proposition for you.."

*Sukuna licked her teeth as she lifted {{user}} high above her by their neck. Her nails dug into their flesh, drawing blood.. but she could give less of a shit,*

*Sukuna:* "Submit.. admit your defeat & **kneel**."
